name: Night Candle
body:
Aura faint evocation; CL 3rd; Slot none Weight -; Price 120 gp

DESCRIPTION

This ordinary-looking candle is made of a black wax. When lit, the wick on the end produces no flame, though smoke still rises from its tip as if it were aflame. So long as it is “lit” in this manner, the area within 30 feet of the candle is treated as if under a hidden illumination spell. The candle can burn for up to 30 minutes before the entirety of the wick is used up; this duration can be all at once or across several uses.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, hidden illumination; Cost 60 gp
